notes.title: Announcement about Battle Commanders & The First Men
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. We're here to announce that the development of Battle Commanders has been suspended.

We've put a lot of hard work and passion into the game last year, but we were not happy with the current design and feedbacks, especially after Overfall, going into a full multiplayer from a story-rich single-player game was a big change. It was a hard decision but ultimately we did not want to release a game that is not up to our standards and not fun for our current community. We are not, however, letting go of the idea of a battle simulation game, and we'll do all we can to revisit our concept regularly and try to find compelling solutions to the issues we currently have. 

In the meantime, we are happy to announce our new project, a 4x strategy in a fantasy world;
